claims: Lauren Betts and Sienna Betts play for the UCLA Bruins women's basketball team.
Lauren Betts is a senior center.
Lauren Betts is an All-American.
Sienna Betts is the younger sister of Lauren Betts.
Sienna Betts is a freshman.
Lauren Betts and Sienna Betts joined forces in the 2025-26 season.
Lauren Betts and Sienna Betts led the UCLA Bruins women's basketball team to the Final Four.
Lauren Betts is a 6′7" center.
Lauren Betts is a 2025 First-Team AP All-American.
Lauren Betts won the Lisa Leslie Award.
Sienna Betts is a 6′4" freshman center.
Sienna Betts joined UCLA in November 2024.
Lauren Betts and Sienna Betts played together in high school.
Lauren Betts and Sienna Betts won a state championship together in high school in Lauren Betts’s senior year.
Andy Betts and Michelle Betts are the parents of Lauren Betts and Sienna Betts.
Andy Betts and Michelle Betts both played college sports.
Andy Betts was a 1998 NBA draft pick.
Andy Betts had a professional career in Europe.
Lauren Betts and Sienna Betts were born in Europe.
In July 2025, Lauren Betts and Sienna Betts were signed by Unrivaled to NIL deals.
Unrivaled is a 3×3 basketball league
